# {{ site.title }}

> Family events on Washington's Eastside, updated daily. Events link to the original sources.

## Cities

{%- for city in site.data.cities %}
- [{{ city.name }}]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/{{ city.id }}/): {{ city.description | strip }}
{%- endfor %}

## About

- [About]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/about/): A local parent with three kids. Free family events across 15 Eastside cities.
- Blurbs are original and link to sources.

## Seasons

{%- for hub in site.data.seasonal_hubs %}
- [{{ hub.title }}]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}{{ hub.path }}): {{ hub.llms }} In season {{ hub.season_label }}. The page stays up all year.
{%- endfor %}
- [Worth the drive]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/worth-the-drive/): Family outings a little outside the Eastside, with the town and a rough drive time from Bellevue. The page stays up all year.
- [Christmas lights map]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/christmas/lights/): Homes and neighborhood streets with Christmas lights, on one map. Public displays stay on the Christmas page.

## Summer camps

- [Summer camps]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/summer-camps/): Day camps for Eastside kids in summer 2027. One list, grouped by town, that can also be grouped by type, sign-up date, or age. A 2027 date is listed only when the camp's own site has posted it. The page stays up all year.

## This weekend

- [This weekend]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/this-weekend/): Friday through Sunday family events in all 15 cities, grouped by day. Rebuilt daily.

## Playgrounds

- [Playground map]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/playgrounds/): Surveyed public park playgrounds in the 15 Eastside cities, with a click-to-load map. Covington parks are listed with Maple Valley. Town and amenity filters narrow the list before the map loads.

## Farmers markets

- [Farmers markets]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/farmers-markets/): Weekly farmers markets in the 15 cities, with the day, hours, and season. The page says which markets are open now.

## Book ahead

- [Book ahead]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/book-ahead/): Ticketed family events in the 15 cities that sell out and need a booking weeks ahead. The page says whether tickets are on sale now or the day they go on sale. Sold-out events come off the list. Summer camps are not listed.

## School calendars

- [School calendars]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/no-school-days/): No-school days, early release, and breaks for the 2026-27 year in the ten Eastside school districts. Grade-only days and days that are off only if needed are marked. Each district has a calendar feed.

## Articles

- [Articles]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/articles/): Evergreen guides for Eastside families.
- [Best Christmas lights on the Eastside]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/articles/christmas-lights/): Public displays, two posted home shows, and zoo light walks within reach.
- [Meeting Santa on the Eastside]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/articles/meeting-santa/): Free and low-cost Santa visits, tree lightings, and the Santa trains.
- [Winter break with kids on the Eastside]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/articles/winter-break/): Break dates, indoor plans, and a snow day at Snoqualmie Pass.
- [New Year's Eve with kids on the Eastside]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/articles/new-years-eve/): What is open on December 31, and which noon countdowns are still unannounced.
- [Snow play near the Eastside]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/articles/snow-play/): Summit tubing, the Hyak sledding hill, and the pass check.

## Sitemap

- [Sitemap]({{ site.url }}{{ site.baseurl }}/sitemap.xml): Every public page on this site.
